Recall@K.population: Four original question/mode selections with recorded retrieval candidates; two original scope failures excluded and separately disclosed
Recall@K.method: Re-score unchanged K=5 selections against frozen source-bound facts (Recall) and exhaustive binary child labels within the one-file 10-child corpus (Precision, Hit, MRR, NDCG). Precision divides by five. MRR cutoff five; misses zero. Binary gain and log2 rank discount. These are frozen-rank diagnostics, not new retrieval performance.

Final evidence coverage.population: Sixteen requested fact instances across four original requests with recorded candidates
Final evidence coverage.method: Exact source-bound target cells, row labels, complete parent/leaf header paths and period cells must occur in packed evidence with matching tuples and source text; prose requires all original phrases. Audit the actual serialized body/pages/offsets/table JSON/supplements for lossless correspondence. Count all required points without partial credit.

Stage latency.population: One sequential local call per frozen input per phase
Stage latency.method: perf_counter around pack_evidence and separately document_references plus resolve_document_scope. Tokenizer preloaded; includes actual context formatting/token counting; excludes model loading, queueing, retrieval, network and answer generation. Tiny single-pass diagnostics do not establish production latency or speedup.
Stage latency.aggregation: arithmetic mean and linearly interpolated p50/p95

Token usage and cost.unit: local cl100k_base tokens; no provider billing
Token usage and cost.population: Six serialized local evidence contexts per phase
Token usage and cost.method: Actual numbered build_context output encoded with cl100k_base at unchanged max_tokens=4096. No API input/output tokens or model billing inferred.
